_purpose: Seed replicates of the K3 memory axis only. The original sweep in train_zoo_spec.json trains one model per context length, which gives the Mem-Ctrl trend no error bars: the offline metrics are deterministic given a checkpoint, so re-running evaluation seeds cannot tell us whether the trend survives retraining. These replicates re-train the same five context lengths under two further seeds so the trend can be reported as a mean over three independent training runs per point.
_preregistered: 2026-09-01, added after the first memory sweep finished but BEFORE any replicate was trained. This adds statistical power to an already-registered axis; it introduces no new hypothesis and no new metric. All 10 models are reported.
_identical_to_originals_except_seed: batch 20 and EPOCHS/2 are copied from train_zoo_spec.json so a replicate differs from its original in the seed alone.
